name: Colowide Co.,Ltd.
summary: Colowide Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in restaurant management business in Japan and internationally. It also engages in purchasing and selling various foodstuffs and processing sales, as well as tobacco and alcoholic beverages. The company also manufactures and sells confectioneries, baked goods, and chocolates, as well as sauces for commercial and consumer use; sells and distributes liquors and other related beverages; and provides catering services.
